components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one solid-green action per decision point: 交卷, 練這一節, confirm.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font: inherit; cursor: pointer; background: var(--accent, #196f5a); color: var(--on-accent, #ffffff); border: 1px solid var(--accent, #196f5a); border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 18px; min-height: 44px; font-weight: 800; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-strong, #14342b); border-color: var(--accent-strong, #14342b); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #196f5a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Back, tools, and navigation buttons: panel fill, hairline, green text.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-secondary"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="20" height="20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M19 12H5M12 19l-7-7 7-7"/></svg>目錄</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { font: inherit; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; background: var(--panel, #fffdf8); color: var(--accent, #196f5a); border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(22,33,27,0.14)); border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 14px; min-height: 44px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--accent, #196f5a); background: var(--accent-soft, #edf7f1); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #196f5a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Answer Choice
components.description: Full-width answer row; the letter circle is hollow at rest and fills when chosen, correct, or wrong.
components.css: .ds-choices { display: grid; gap: 10px; } .ds-choice { font: inherit; cursor: pointer; display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; text-align: left; line-height: 1.6; padding: 14px; background: var(--panel-raised, #ffffff); color: var(--text, #16211b); border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(22,33,27,0.14)); border-radius: 8px; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out, border-color 120ms ease-out, box-shadow 120ms ease-out; } .ds-choice-id { width: 28px; height: 28px; flex: none; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 50%; color: var(--accent, #196f5a); font-weight: 800; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--accent, #196f5a); } .ds-choice:not(.is-selected):not(.is-wrong):hover { border-color: var(--accent, #196f5a); background: var(--accent-soft, #edf7f1); } .ds-choice.is-selected { border-color: var(--accent, #196f5a); background: var(--accent-tint, #dcefe5); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--accent, #196f5a); } .ds-choice.is-selected .ds-choice-id { background: var(--accent, #196f5a); color: var(--on-accent, #fff); box-shadow: none; } .ds-choice.is-wrong { border-color: var(--wrong, #a84a3a); background: var(--wrong-soft, #fff4ed); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--wrong, #a84a3a); } .ds-choice.is-wrong .ds-choice-id { background: var(--wrong, #a84a3a); color: var(--on-accent, #fff); box-shadow: none; } .ds-choice:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #196f5a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Choice Card
components.description: Top-level certificate / level / mode / subject card with soft lift.
components.css: .ds-card { font: inherit; cursor: pointer; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; width: 100%; text-align: left; padding: 18px; background: var(--panel, #fffdf8); color: var(--text, #16211b); border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(22,33,27,0.14)); border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 6px 18px var(--shadow, rgba(18,35,28,0.05)); } .ds-card-title { color: var(--accent, #196f5a); font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-card-body { color: var(--muted, #43524b); line-height: 1.6; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: var(--accent, #196f5a); background: var(--accent-soft, #edf7f1); } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #196f5a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Badges
components.description: Topic badge (quiet panel-alt) beside the amber provenance badge for LLM-authored questions.
components.html: L11101 人工智慧概念AI 命題・待複審
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; padding: 3px 10px; margin-right: 6px; background: var(--panel-alt, #e7efe9); color: var(--muted, #43524b); border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(22,33,27,0.14)); border-radius: 999px; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-badge-warn { background: var(--warn-bg, #fdf3e3); color: var(--warn-fg, #8a5a1b); border-color: var(--warn-border, #e0bd83); }

components.name: Section Chips
components.description: Reader section-chip track; the current section fills green.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-chip { font: inherit; cursor: pointer; min-height: 40px; padding: 6px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(22,33,27,0.14)); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--panel, #fffdf8); color: var(--text, #16211b); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; transition: background-color 160ms ease-out, color 160ms ease-out, border-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-chip.is-current { background: var(--accent, #196f5a); border-color: var(--accent, #196f5a); color: var(--on-accent, #fff); } .ds-chip:not(.is-current):hover { border-color: var(--accent, #196f5a); background: var(--accent-soft, #edf7f1); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #196f5a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Study-index search with a muted inline SVG icon.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="20" height="20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="M20 20l-3.5-3.5"/></svg><input type="search" placeholder="搜尋節點、縮寫或筆記內文"></label>
components.css: .ds-search { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; } .ds-search svg { position: absolute; left: 13px; color: var(--muted, #43524b); pointer-events: none; } .ds-search input { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 12px 10px 42px; font: inherit; font-size: 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(22,33,27,0.14)); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--panel-raised, #fff); color: var(--text, #16211b); } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: var(--muted, #43524b); } .ds-search input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #196f5a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Node List
components.description: One rounded panel of flat node rows divided by inset hairlines; green tabular code, read-mark ring.
components.css: .ds-nodes { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; background: var(--panel, #fffdf8); border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(22,33,27,0.14)); border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-nodes > li + li { box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 var(--border, rgba(22,33,27,0.14)); } .ds-node { font: inherit; cursor: pointer; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 3.6em 1fr 24px; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 100%; min-height: 60px; padding: 12px 16px; text-align: left; border: none; background: transparent; color: var(--text, #16211b); } .ds-node:hover { background: var(--accent-soft, #edf7f1); } .ds-node:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #196f5a); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-code { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 800; color: var(--accent, #196f5a); letter-spacing: 0.01em; } .ds-node-text { display: grid; gap: 2px; } .ds-node-title { font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.45; } .ds-node-meta { color: var(--muted, #43524b); font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-state { width: 22px; height: 22px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--border, rgba(22,33,27,0.14)); } .ds-node.is-read .ds-state { background: var(--accent, #196f5a); color: var(--on-accent, #fff); box-shadow: none; } .ds-node.is-read .ds-node-title { color: var(--muted, #43524b); }

components.name: Reader Dock
components.description: Fixed glass bottom bar: prev, read toggle, primary drill, next.
components.html: <nav class="ds-dock"><button class="ds-step" aria-label="上一節"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="20" height="20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M15 18l-6-6 6-6"/></svg></button><button class="ds-read">標記已讀</button><button class="ds-drill">練 10 題</button><button class="ds-step" aria-label="下一節"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="20" height="20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M9 18l6-6-6-6"/></svg></button></nav>
components.css: .ds-dock { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto auto 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; background: var(--bar-bg, rgba(245,242,235,0.94)); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 var(--border, rgba(22,33,27,0.14)); } .ds-dock button { font: inherit; cursor: pointer; min-height: 44px; border-radius: 10px; } .ds-step { min-width: 44px; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(22,33,27,0.14)); background: var(--panel, #fffdf8); color: var(--accent, #196f5a); } .ds-read { padding: 6px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(22,33,27,0.14)); background: var(--panel, #fffdf8); color: var(--muted, #43524b); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-drill { padding: 8px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--accent, #196f5a); background: var(--accent, #196f5a); color: var(--on-accent, #fff); font-weight: 800; } .ds-step:hover { border-color: var(--accent, #196f5a); background: var(--accent-soft, #edf7f1); } .ds-read:hover { border-color: var(--accent, #196f5a); color: var(--accent, #196f5a); } .ds-drill:hover { background: var(--accent-strong, #14342b); border-color: var(--accent-strong, #14342b); } .ds-dock button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #196f5a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-formula { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; gap: 4px 10px; background: var(--accent-soft, #edf7f1); border: 1px solid var(--accent-tint, #dcefe5); padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px; margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-formula-label { font-weight: 600; } .ds-formula code { font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.95rem; color: var(--accent, #196f5a); } .ds-formula-note { color: var(--muted, #43524b); font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-table-wrap { overflow-x: auto; margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-table { border-collapse: collapse; min-width: 100%; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-table th, .ds-table td { border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(22,33,27,0.14)); padding: 6px 10px; text-align: left; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-table thead th { background: var(--accent-soft, #edf7f1); color: var(--accent, #196f5a); font-weight: 700; } .ds-table tbody td:first-child { font-weight: 600; } .ds-flow { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 4px; list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; } .ds-flow li { background: var(--panel, #fffdf8); border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(22,33,27,0.14)); border-radius: 999px; padding: 2px 10px; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-flow li + li::before { content: "\2192"; color: var(--muted, #43524b); margin-right: 8px; }

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Green-Ink Study Ledger"**

The site reads like a well-kept exam notebook: warm paper ground, near-black green ink, and a single deep-green pen used for everything that is yours to press or that marks where you are. It is a working tool for people studying in short phone sessions, so density is moderate, every control is a full thumb-sized target, and the chrome stays quiet so the question, the answer, and the node code carry the page.

Depth is soft and rare. Top-level choices (certificate, level, mode, subject) sit on lightly lifted cards; everything inside a panel is flat and separated by hairlines rather than by nested boxes. State is shown by fill, not by decoration: a choice letter circle is hollow until chosen, a section chip is outlined until it is the current one, a node's read-mark is an empty ring until it is filled green. The same green also fills the one primary action on any screen.

Color carries meaning, never mood. Green is identity and action; a muted sage green is "correct"; brick red is "wrong"; amber is reserved for provenance warnings (AI 命題・待複審) and search hits. Dark mode is the same ledger by lamplight: every semantic token is swapped as a set, never redesigned.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper ground (#f5f2eb) with off-white panels, one green accent.
A single system sans stack with explicit Traditional Chinese faces; tabular figures for every code, count, and timer.
44px minimum tap target on every interactive control.
Hairline dividers drawn with inset box-shadow; flat rows inside one rounded panel instead of nested cards.
Fill-to-select state language (letter circles, chips, read-marks, exam-map cells).
Hover styling exists only for real pointers; touch never sees sticky hover.

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: Green is the only hue for identity and action. If something is pressable, current, or the primary next step, it is green; nothing else on the page competes with it.

rules.name: The Warning Is Not Wrong Rule
rules.body: Provenance cautions use amber, never brick red. Red means "you answered wrong" and nothing else.

rules.name: The Two-Place Dark Rule
rules.body: Every color token is declared on `:root` and given a dark value in both `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` and `:root[data-theme="dark"]`. A color that exists only in light mode is a bug.

rules.name: The No-Shrinking-Headings Rule
rules.body: h4 and h5 are never smaller than body text (1.0625rem and up); lower levels are distinguished by weight and placement, not by shrinking.

rules.name: The Tabular Anchor Rule
rules.body: Node codes (L11101, A1.1), question numbers, counts, timers, and percentages always set `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`; node codes are additionally 800 weight in green so they anchor each row and each reader page.

rules.name: The Flat-Inside Rule
rules.body: Lift belongs to the outermost card or a floating layer. Rows, sections, and blocks inside a panel are flat; never nest a shadowed card in a shadowed card.

rules.name: The Glass Bar Rule
rules.body: Every sticky or fixed bar uses `bar-bg` with a 10px backdrop blur and a 1px hairline toward the content, never a solid fill or a drop shadow.

dos: **Do** take every color and font size from the `:root` tokens, and give any new color a dark value in both dark-mode blocks.
**Do** make every interactive control at least 44px tall (`--tap`); compact secondary chips may go to 40px, no lower.
**Do** write hover rules only inside the trailing `@media (hover: hover)` block.
**Do** separate rows and sections with `inset 0 1px 0 var(--border)` hairlines and group rows into one rounded panel.
**Do** show selection by filling (letter circle, chip, read-mark, map cell) plus a green border with inset ring.
**Do** set codes, counts, timers, and scores in tabular figures; prefix node titles with the green node code.
**Do** let wide content (tables, code, chip tracks) scroll inside its own wrapper.
**Do** use inline SVG icons (2px stroke, `currentColor`) for any new icon.
donts: **Don't** use a colored side border thicker than 1px as an accent; use a fill, a full hairline border, or an inset hairline instead.
**Don't** use brick red for warnings or provenance; red is only "wrong answer", failing score, low time, or destructive action.
**Don't** introduce a second accent hue or a decorative gradient.
**Don't** nest shadowed cards inside shadowed panels.
**Don't** put more than one solid-green primary action in the same decision area.
**Don't** let the page scroll horizontally on mobile.
